name: flyover-vegetation
notes: Per-sector vegetation and obstacles on the flyover's relief (alien trees, crystal shrubs, fungal stalks, thorn brush, ruined debris) that the ground fleet pushes through. Every value is an input to tools/vegetation (Go, stdlib only). Silhouettes and every frame (idle sway, push bend, topple / shatter / flatten / shove, settled) are authored on the texel grid; each species' selected ComfyUI keyframe (LayerDiffuse transparent sprite) contributes a -1/0/+1 shading texture on its body ramp. Body ramps are picked from the sector palette at the body_luma targets (chroma <= caps.chroma), pulled toward the species hint hue; accents use the species accent at glow_luma.
style_prompt: pixel art, 16-bit arcade game sprite, single plant seen from a high 3/4 view, night lighting, dark muted colours, crisp square pixels, original artwork, centered, isolated
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, horizon, clouds, landscape, scenery, people, animals, vehicles, cute, cartoon, many objects, bright colours
